title: Architecture Overview
desc: The big-picture map of Studio 2.0 subsystems and ownership.
lede: A map of the 2.0 subsystems and who owns what, plus how a request flows end to end.
body:
At a glance
  • Clear ownership: orchestrator, watchdog, voice bridge.
  • A request flows app → bridge → TTS Server → engine.
  • No import-time side effects.

Ownership split

  • Orchestrator — schedules and recovers work.
  • Watchdog — supervises the TTS Server process.
  • Voice bridge — the only route from a request to an engine.

Request flow

A synthesis request travels app → voice bridge → TTS Server → engine, and results come back as normalized artifacts and progress. See VoiceBridge and TTS Server & Watchdog.

No import-time side effects

Importing a module must not start servers, load models, or touch the filesystem. Startup happens in one explicit place — see Boot Sequence.
